sentences.text:
Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
 or proceedings
Sl.
 Date or directions Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  16.04.2024 IA No.1406 of 2023 (Second Bail Application)
 In  CRLA No.289 of 2016  Hon'ble Ritu Bahri, C.J.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
1.
None is present for the appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate General, for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. As per the custody certificate, the appellant has undergone 15 years 9 months 12 days in custody,
including remission.

The appellant has been convicted under sections 498A and 302 of IPC.
4.

The appellant is not facing any other criminal trial, and the appeal is of the year 2016, and it is not likely to come up for hearing in the near future, and without commenting on the merits of the matter, bail application is allowed and the sentence of the present applicant Man Singh is also suspended.
Let appellant Man Singh be released on bail, during the pendency of the present criminal appeal, on suitable terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the learned trial Judge.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Ritu Bahri, C.J.) 16.04.2024 NR/
CRLA/289/2016 on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149376807/
